title: Counter
js: let n = 0; const out = document.getElementById('count'); document.getElementById('add').onclick = () => { out.textContent = String(++n); }; document.getElementById('reset').onclick = () => { n = 0; out.textContent = '0'; };
fallback: Starts at zero. Add one increments the count; Reset returns it to zero. Changes last only while this interface is running.
